WebCompare Desktop — third-party licenses and source

The same WebCompare release provides the corresponding source archive named
webcompare-desktop-<version>-corresponding-source.tar.gz. It includes sources
and build materials for the bundled libvips and its static dependencies,
Paramiko, and the Ubuntu PyGObject and Pycairo used on Linux.

Download the archive beside the matching desktop packages at
https://github.com/fenghansen/WebCompare/releases

The notices and licence texts for the bundled components are in this directory
and the source archive. Paramiko and Ubuntu PyGObject are supplied under the
GNU Lesser General Public License. For Pycairo see python3-cairo/copyright
and the source archive. For libvips and the libraries linked inside it, see
libvips-runtime/SOURCE.txt, the accompanying component notices, and the
GNU LGPL, GNU GPL and Mozilla Public License texts in libvips-runtime.

Close WebCompare before replacing a bundled library. Start from a separate
copy of the extracted application, then use the same relative names:

* Paramiko: edit or replace the Python files in _internal/paramiko.
* PyGObject and Pycairo (Linux): edit or replace _internal/gi and
  _internal/cairo. The native modules in those directories require a
  compatible Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 / CPython 3.12 build.
* libvips: replace the actual libvips library in the portable application's
  _internal directory, preserving the filename and ABI required by the
  included _libvips extension. That includes the platform-specific wheel
  directory/name shown in bundle-manifest.json.

The source archive includes rebuild and replacement instructions. Stop the
application and its background processes, then run the same executable
from the modified copy. The terms of the covered libraries permit modifying
them and reverse engineering the application's library interface to debug
such modifications.
